The '''H9 pistol grip''' was a device allowing a weapon to be used one-handed. It was produced by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Arms]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and cost 400 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="DC" />
